description: constraints.flutter pins the Flutter SDK Renovate uses to regenerate pubspec.lock. Keep it equal to flutter-version in .github/workflows/test.yml; a newer SDK can fail to resolve against the exact-pinned pubspec.yaml.

minimumReleaseAge holds back every update until the release is 7 days old, giving time for a compromised or broken release to be noticed and pulled before it reaches pubspec.lock (supply-chain safeguard; see Dependency Version Pinning in CLAUDE.md). Pending updates are listed on the Dependency Dashboard issue. vulnerabilityAlerts sets it to null so security fixes are not delayed.

packageRules.description: Keep Gradle/Kotlin dependencies pinned to exact versions, matching the pubspec.yaml pinning policy in CLAUDE.md.
Group Android/Kotlin test-only dependencies (JUnit, org.json, etc.) into a single PR to reduce PR noise.
